title: Aladdin Sentinel Inventory
description: Normative schema for the inventory a sentinel repository watches. The sentinel exists because a repository cannot reliably report its own silence: when its scheduled workflows are disabled, the thing that would notice is disabled with them. The inventory declares which repositories are watched and what counts as too quiet for each.

defaults.description: Applied to every repository that does not override them.

repository.description: Owner and name, for example Jin-Aladdin/aladdin-spec.

role.description: What the repository is. A specification repository is not expected to run knowledge updates, so it is not reported for their absence.

recovery.description: How the sentinel may try to restart a silent repository. Dispatch is a request to run a declared workflow; it never edits content.

dispatch_event.description: repository_dispatch event type the target accepts.

open_issues.description: Open or update an issue in the sentinel repository when a watched repository is unhealthy.

fail_workflow_on_unhealthy.description: Whether an unhealthy target should fail the sentinel run. Failing makes the signal loud; not failing keeps the history readable when a target is knowingly dormant.

thresholds.description: Ages after which silence becomes a finding. Every threshold is optional: a check with no threshold is not performed, which is how a repository opts out of a check that does not apply to it.

validation_max_age_days.description: Age of the last successful validation run.

update_max_age_days.description: Age of the last successful knowledge update run.

release_max_age_days.description: Age of the most recent release.

commit_max_age_days.description: Age of the newest commit. Prolonged inactivity is what causes a platform to disable scheduled workflows, so this is the leading indicator of coming silence.

require_enabled_workflows.description: Report a scheduled workflow that the platform has disabled.
